---
title: "Tools — Environment"
format: html
---

This file centralises the small header shown at the start of notebooks. The specific kernel
snippet is automatically injected at render time based on the frontmatter `jupyter:` value
by the `_quarto-utils/_include-tools.lua` filter.

The snippets are located in `_quarto-utils/snippets/<kernel>.qmd` and contain `when-profile`
blocks so they render correctly for `notes` and `slides`.
